project.name: ACD
project.description: Autonomous Coding Dashboard: dispatches PRDs and supervises Claude Code agents across target repositories.

entrypoints.summary: Fast repo orientation, read order, operational truths, and token-saving skip rules.
Task router for which docs and code files to read first.
Product overview, directory map, install/run commands, dispatch flow, feature schema, MCP tool groups, and spawned-agent capabilities.
Rules and conventions for editing ACD itself.
OAuth, worktrees, ACD tools, fleet waves, monitoring, independent review gates, recovery, security boundaries, and current app-wave lessons.

known_hazards.summary: acd_dispatch calls feature generation, which currently requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, while the coding harness rejects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for OAuth-only Claude Code child sessions.
known_hazards.safe_path: Write PRD and feature JSON explicitly, then call acd_start with absolute promptPath, featureListPath, and targetPath.

known_hazards.summary: Multiple coding agents must not write to the same checkout.
known_hazards.safe_path: Use one branch and one dedicated worktree per running task.

known_hazards.summary: PID files and manager-reported sessions can outlive real child processes.
known_hazards.safe_path: Correlate ACD status, PID, logs, process table, git status, and worktree changes before stopping or accepting a run.

canonical_code.role: Path and port source of truth. Import from here; do not hardcode paths.
ACD MCP server and acd_* tool implementation.
Priority queue and worker slot execution.

do_not_index_by_default: data/features/*.json except the task slug in scope
